name: test_fullapi_qtproxy
description: Qt-typed C++ consumer/proxy for the full_api contract. `type: core` with NO `interface` key, so the builder picks apiStyle=qt and the generated interface wrapper is Qt-typed (QString / QByteArray / qlonglong / qulonglong / QVariantList / QVariantMap / LogosResult) — the THIRD consumer surface of the conformance matrix, distinct from the lp-typed universal proxy and the Rust cdylib proxy. Forwards every full_api method to the bound provider and re-emits every event, so the matrix replays cases.json through it unchanged.
